notes: All 13 source and 20 target IDs partitioned exactly once.

πᾶς ὁ ἀσκῶν-type phrase: the ASV writes a second English word for the article, so rule 80's *whosoever* compression does not apply and the ordinary three-way split *every* / *one* / *that asketh* holds (rules 22, 32, 80).
τῷ takes *to him* with the case preposition riding along, headed on the nominal *him* rather than on the preposition (rules 21, 22).
